name: GeoIP
description: GeoIP databases used to resolve the country, ASN and city of a client IP.

MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY.help: MaxMind license key. When set, the country, ASN and city databases are downloaded from MaxMind instead of DB-IP.
MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY.label: MaxMind license key

MAXMIND_ACCOUNT_ID.help: MaxMind account ID. Optional but recommended: without it the deprecated key-only endpoint is used, which carries the license key in the URL instead of an auth header.
MAXMIND_ACCOUNT_ID.label: MaxMind account ID

GEOIP_CITY.help: Download the city database. It is far bigger than the others (DB-IP City Lite unpacks to 125 MB) and is not bundled in the images.
GEOIP_CITY.label: City database

GEOIP_COUNTRY_MMDB.help: Custom country database: absolute path readable by the worker, or http(s) URL. Takes priority over MaxMind and DB-IP.
GEOIP_COUNTRY_MMDB.label: Custom country database

GEOIP_ASN_MMDB.help: Custom ASN database: absolute path readable by the worker, or http(s) URL. Takes priority over MaxMind and DB-IP.
GEOIP_ASN_MMDB.label: Custom ASN database

GEOIP_CITY_MMDB.help: Custom city database: absolute path readable by the worker, or http(s) URL. Takes priority over MaxMind and DB-IP.
GEOIP_CITY_MMDB.label: Custom city database
